description: Find accounting transactions—called Portfolio Transactions in Tokenbooks—for review or reconciliation; filter by status, type, errors, spam, wallet, or asset, optionally attaching grouped contributing raw source records (10-record page cap). Pass transactionId to explain full details of one transaction instead: classification, journal entry, cost-basis links, and (rawWithDetails) its sanitized event logs and contract calls.

defiPositionKey.description: Filter by protocol-defined DeFi position key

defiPositionWalletAddress.description: Filter by DeFi position wallet address

defiPositionWalletChainId.description: Filter by DeFi position wallet chain ID

hasError.description: true: has a processing error; false: error-free

hasJournalEntry.description: true: has a non-empty journal entry; false: does not

hasLots.description: true: produced cost-basis lots; false: did not

include.description: Include grouped contributing raw source transactions; rawWithDetails adds sanitized provider details and requires transactionId

isSpam.description: true: transfers involve spam tokens; false: non-spam only

anyOf.description: Maximum Portfolio Transactions to return, maximum 100.
Maximum Portfolio Transactions to return, maximum 100. Numeric strings are accepted for MCP client compatibility.

limit.description: Maximum Portfolio Transactions to return, maximum 100.

maxValue.description: Maximum transfer fiat quote value (inclusive), as a decimal string

minValue.description: Minimum transfer fiat quote value (inclusive), as a decimal string

pageToken.description: Opaque token returned by the previous list response.

portfolioRef.description: Portfolio name or slug inside that workspace. Call list_portfolios to resolve it.

responsibilityCenterTypeKeys.description: Filter by journal-line responsibility-center type key (e.g. primary, goal; from list_journal_line_assignment_options)

items.description: Stable responsibility-center type key. It uses lowercase alphanumeric snake_case segments.

search.description: Free-text search over memo, tx hash, transaction ID

sort.description: Timestamp sort. Prefix with - for descending order.

transactionId.description: Look up one transaction by handle instead of listing

txHash.description: Filter by exact on-chain transaction hash

walletAddress.description: Public wallet address on the selected chain.

workspaceRef.description: Workspace name or slug. Call list_workspaces to resolve it.

name: list_portfolio_transactions
title: List Portfolio Transactions
